input.subject: Fwd: Downtown buyer - 2BR condo FiDi/BPC to $1.6M
input.bodyText:
Passing this along to my downtown contacts - I know a few of you work FiDi. Anything coming soon?

Greg

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Lauren Petrakis <lpetrakis@elliman.com>
Sent: Saturday, August 1, 2026 9:12 AM
To: Elliman Downtown Team
Subject: Downtown buyer - 2BR condo FiDi/BPC to $1.6M

Team,

My buyer is relocating and needs to be downtown near the office. Criteria:
- 2BR / 2BA condo
- Financial District or Battery Park City
- Budget up to $1.6M
- Doorman building, gym a plus
- Ready to close, financing pre-approved

Co-broke welcome. Send anything that fits.

> Lauren Petrakis
